prompts:
Use case: illustration-story. Create archer-b.png, a production animation sprite sheet for Riley Wheel Brawl 2.0. Use attached Image 1 master-side.png as the LOCKED character and art reference, matching face, beard, white hood UP, muddy white cloak, gold sunburst on left breast, brown jerkin, gray chainmail, bracers, trousers, boots, quiver with white fletching and belt knife exactly.
Output landscape 1536x1024, genuinely transparent RGBA background, no ground shadows. EXACTLY EIGHT full-body figures in TWO rows of FOUR, evenly spaced in four 384px-wide cells per row. Shared foot baseline per row, generous transparent gaps, no overlaps or clipping including longbows. Same anatomical scale across all eight; maximize figure size within cells. All face LEFT in side/slight three-quarter view. One consistent tall wooden longbow with recurved tips, same length and curve in all frames (string flex changes with draw). No shields.
Style exactly reference: hand-drawn HD 2D fighting-game art, confident near-black/dark-brown outlines thick outside thin inside, clean 2-3 step cel shading with subtle painterly gradients, grounded rich colors, soft upper-left light and slight cool right rim. Not pixel art, not 3D, not photoreal, not chibi.
Reading order:
TOP LEFT frame 1 RELEASE: left bow arm extended toward LEFT, bow upright, string just snapped forward relaxed, arrow GONE, right drawing fingers opening beside face.
TOP SECOND frame 2 FOLLOW-THROUGH: lowering longbow with left hand, right hand reaches back toward quiver for next arrow.
TOP THIRD frame 3 BACKSTEP airborne: hops backward toward RIGHT while facing LEFT, both boots visibly raised above row baseline, knees flexed, bow held up.
TOP FOURTH frame 4 BACKSTEP LANDING: both boots land on baseline, knees deeply bent absorbing landing, still facing LEFT, bow held up.
BOTTOM LEFT frame 5 SKY DRAW: full draw with ONE arrow nocked, aiming 45 degrees toward upper LEFT, bow tilted for high shot, drawing hand at cheek, leaning back.
BOTTOM SECOND frame 6 SKY RELEASE: arrow GONE, string snapped forward, fingers open, longbow still angled up toward upper LEFT.
BOTTOM THIRD frame 7 HURT FACE: head snaps backward toward RIGHT from hit to face, torso recoils, hood remains up and face visible, still oriented LEFT, holding bow, no attacker.
BOTTOM FOURTH frame 8 HURT GUT: doubles forward over abdomen from gut hit, staggering backward RIGHT while facing LEFT, knees buckled, one hand over gut and other retains bow.
Each is a genuinely different drawing of the next motion moment, never duplicated or mirrored. Correct anatomy exactly two arms, two legs, two booted feet, five-fingered hands. Keep same clothing and weapon proportions throughout. Full figures and entire bows fit within their separate cells. NO text, labels, frame numbers, borders, floor, background, dust, effects, motion lines, blood or gore. Actual transparent alpha, not a painted checkerboard.
